geometry_basis: The previous four-section layout preflight checked all 175 cue boxes and six narrow stills; its drawtext implementation was rejected before render.
one_frame_filter_probe: Passed crop, pad, trim, setpts, fps, format and transparent overlay on the P02 presenter frame.

source_reproduction_note: The committed renderer recreates a one-frame concat/transparent-overlay probe from the exact local v15 MP4, validates every cue text box, and fails closed if the local input hash differs. Voice-bearing MP4 inputs are not committed.
